items.text: Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 1% after the index surged on Monday, while the Dollar Index held above 104, its highest level since March 2025.

items.title: Asian tech stocks recover from ‘collateral damage’ of Jensen Huang’s departure
items.text: Investors piled back into the tech market, following the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang by its board.

items.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
items.text: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

items.title: Rückkehr von Nvidia-Chef: "Nie dagewesenes Verwischen von Grenzen"
items.text: Eine Rückkehr von Jensen Huang an die Spitze des Chipherstellers Nvidia haben die Wenigsten erwartet. Die Suche nach den Gründen des Comebacks führt bis zur Spitze der US-Regierung. Das kritisieren nicht nur die Demokraten. Von Antje Sieb.

items.title: Nvidia-Skandal: US-Regierung setzt Megaspeed auf schwarze Liste
items.text: Die Firma Megaspeed erlangte innerhalb kurzer Zeit weltweite Aufmerksamkeit. Grund war die Affäre von Nvidia-Chef Huang mit einer früheren Managerin des Unternehmens, die der Spionage verdächtigt wird. Nun landete Megaspeed auf einer US-Sperrliste.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
items.text: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.

items.title: AI adoption grows in Asia, but measuring the gains remains tricky
items.text: Businesses across Asia-Pacific are seeing returns from AI investments, even as confidence in measuring those gains varies, according to an AWS survey.

items.title: VW-Tarifrunde beginnt in Emden - wo die Streitpunkte liegen
items.text: Mitten in der tiefsten Krise der Konzerngeschichte startet heute die Tarifrunde für rund 120.000 Volkswagen-Beschäftigte. Das Management will Kosten senken, die IG Metall wehrt sich gegen weitere Einbußen. Von T. Hildebrandt.

items.title: China has changed tactics but is still thwarting India's rise, a U.S. panel says
items.text: China is increasingly focused on containing India economically rather than through military actions.

items.title: U.S. adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export control concerns amid Nvidia controversy
items.text: The U.S. has added Megaspeed and six other companies to its trade blacklist over concerns about the potential diversion of advanced computing products.

items.title: Amazon faces FAA probe after delivery drone strikes Michigan fiber cable, garage
items.text: An Amazon drone "struck a fiber cable, a residential garage, and became entangled in power lines during takeoff," a preliminary FAA report stated.

items.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
items.text: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.

items.title: CrowdStrike CEO defends Zscaler acquisition, calls it a 'winning combination'
items.text: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz defended the company's $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler.

items.title: Peterson: Here’s what Bessent’s about-face on Jensen Huang reveals about Trump and China
items.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was becoming the face of an emerging harder line on Nvidia— until he reversed course

items.title: Mehr Stromspar-Checks für Haushalte mit wenig Geld geplant
items.text: Die Finanzierung des Stromspar-Checks ist für weitere drei Jahre gesichert. Damit können sich Haushalte mit geringem Einkommen kostenlos beraten lassen und Zuschüsse bekommen. Die wichtigsten Fragen und Antworten.

items.title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
items.text: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
items.text: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

items.title: Bitcoin rebound already losing steam as AI trade returns with a bang
items.text: Nvidia jumped more than 30% and has recovered most of its losses since CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but bitcoin is lagging as U.S. selling persists, traders said.

items.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest pulls the plug on two planned crypto ETFs
items.text: ProShares' rival CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF (KRYP) holds $1.81 million in assets nearly 10 months post-launch.

items.title: Affäre von Ex-Nvidia-Chef wohl in Kontakt zu Chinas Geheimdienst
items.text: Alice Huang, Geliebte des ehemaligen Nvidia-Chefs, hatte offenbar mehr als ein Jahr lang Kontakt zu einem Mitarbeiter des chinesischen Geheimdienstes. Die Chinesin steht im Mittelpunkt des Skandals um den US-Chipkonzern.

items.title: Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy
items.text: Recent technology outages have left some worried about AI cyberattacks and the U.S. electricity grid. The doomsday economy is heating up as a result.
